tier_definitions.TIER_1: genuinely different information + feasible with current data + timestampable + testable under current validation discipline
tier_definitions.TIER_3: redundant with V1 or convergent external/internal evidence of no gain vs the line

TIER_1.family: Offensive strategy: PROE + early-down behavior + pace
TIER_1.why: The most structurally absent dimension in V1. V1 knows how efficient a team is per play; it knows nothing about play-calling tendencies (pass rate over expected, early-down/neutral pass rate, pace). xpass/pass_oe ship inside nflfastR PBP (verified locally); everything computable 1999+, weekly, keyless, pregame-safe.
TIER_1.leakage: Low — weekly aggregates of prior games; xpass is a precomputed model, no future info.

TIER_1.why: V1 sees the mean (EPA) and a threshold (success rate) but nothing about the tails: explosive pass/run rates, EPA volatility, aDOT. Multiple public models use explosive-play rate as a core column; it is computable from local PBP today (yards_gained, air_yards, epa all present).
TIER_1.leakage: Low — weekly aggregates of prior games.

TIER_1.why: A genuinely different channel — process (how often the QB is pressured) vs outcome (pass EPA). Weekly team data 2018+, in-season updating, keyless. wadefuller found pressure rate carried real signal (rank 41) but substituted for starter_pass_epa in his model; V1 has no QB-EPA features to displace, so the net-addition case is cleaner here than in his setup.
TIER_1.leakage: Low — weekly team aggregates, batch pre-week.

TIER_2: QB starter continuity/familiarity (small, clean; howlscastle97 kept it for injury work)
Special-teams EPA (Wharton method exists; dgrifka found observability + kickoff-rule breaks)
Drive/field-position (computable; likely partially redundant with EPA)
OL/skill continuity via snap counts (feasible; thin evidence)
FTN charting: motion/play-action/blitz (2022+ only — breaks train window)
Participation time_to_throw/was_pressure/coverage (post-season only 2023+ — no live use)
NGS weekly aggregates (marginal uniqueness at team grain)
TIER_3: QB EPA/dropback form, QB CPOE form, recent QB form (convergent nulls: our v2 + howlscastle97 + colemason6524 + wadefuller)
Matchup interactions (representation, not information; Exp 002 null)
Turnover luck features (dgrifka: luck-stripping gave no OOS gain)
Roof/surface/primetime for spreads (small, likely priced; wind precedent null)

recommended_for_investigation.family: Offensive strategy: PROE + early-down behavior + pace
recommended_for_investigation.justification: Uniqueness: highest — no play-calling information exists anywhere in V1 (ELO/EPA/GBM are all outcome-based). Feasibility: xpass/pass_oe verified in local PBP; early-down splits and pace are simple PBP aggregations over 1999+; weekly cadence; strictly pregame; no paid APIs; timestampable for the 2026 timing study. Leakage: low with weekly batching. This is the single largest structurally-missing dimension, and unlike QB form it has no convergent external null against it.

Uniqueness: high — V1's EPA linear model and success rate see central tendency, not tails; explosive-play rate and EPA volatility describe a different property of the offense (ceiling/variance). Feasibility: fully computable from local 372-col PBP today (yards_gained, air_yards, epa), 1999+, weekly, pregame-safe. Leakage: low. Caveat: explosiveness is high-variance itself, so stability across the 2021-22 validation must be demonstrated, not assumed.

Uniqueness: high — V1 has no process-level line-play signal; pressure rate separates protection quality from QB decision-making (cf. the TTT-vs-pressure decomposition in public analysis). Feasibility: advstats_week_pass verified 2018+ with 2026 in-season updates, keyless; team-week aggregation is straightforward. Leakage: low with pre-week batching. Caveat: wadefuller's ablation found pressure substituted for rather than added to QB-EPA features — but V1 contains no QB-EPA features, so the displacement concern is weaker here; still, the candidate must show diversification (error corr <0.95), not just a good story.

explicitly_not_recommended: QB EPA/CPOE/recent-form features: three independent public ablations plus our own v2 converge on 'no gain vs the close'. Do not re-run this family as Experiment 007.
